MAIN-STREET STANDOFF — a tan-plate frontier main-street flanked by false-front clapboard-tile saloon, general-store, and sheriff-office facades, boardwalk-strip sidewalks, a hitching-post + water-trough build, a central dirt-road of tan 2x4 plates, the suffocating high-noon-tension stage.

SALOON SHOWDOWN — a brick saloon interior with batwing-door builds, a long bar-counter of dark-brown plates, card-table builds, stud-built whiskey-bottle shelves, a piano-build in the corner, an upstairs balcony railing, the volatile-interior tension stage.

TRAIN ROBBERY — a brick steam-locomotive + green boxcars halted on Technic-rail track crossing a stacked-plate trestle bridge, a locked strongbox-car, red-brick desert mesa backdrop of layered tan and orange plates, the high-stakes heist stage.

STAGECOACH CHASE — a brick stagecoach-and-four on a tan-plate winding trail between stacked-plate buttes, a strongbox lashed to the roof-rack, Technic-wheel axles on rough terrain implied, a pursuit rider implied behind, the breathless-trail-danger stage.

GOLD MINE DIG — a brick mine-headframe with a Technic hoist-rig over a deep shaft, narrow ore-cart tracks, a trans-blue sluice-box channel, tailings-pile builds of grey plates, a prospector-camp tent build, the boomtown-labor stage.

GHOST TOWN — a grey-brick frontier town of half-collapsed false-front facades, sagging clapboard-tile walls, a broken-wheel wagon build, a single-brick tumbleweed, boarded-window tiles, a leaning water-tower of dark-tan cylinders, the hollow-eerie abandoned stage.

CAVALRY FORT — a log-effect brick stockade fort with a wide gate, four corner watchtower builds, a flagpole on the parade-ground plate, long barracks-builds, a brick cannon on a carriage, the disciplined frontier-outpost stage.

RIVER-FORD CROSSING — a freight-wagon on a trans-blue + trans-light-blue plate river ford between stacked-plate canyon walls, an ox-team harness build, supply-crates lashed high on the wagon-bed, a scout figure on the gravel-bar bank, the perilous-crossing stage.

BANK HEIST — a brick frontier bank with a wrought-iron teller-cage build, a wide-open vault-door of dark-grey plates, printed money-bag builds stacked by the door, a getaway-horse at the hitching-rail outside, the robbery-in-progress stage.

CAMPFIRE NIGHT — a trans-orange flame-brick campfire ringed by bedroll builds, a coffee-pot on a Technic-rod spit, a picketed horse-build, a covered-wagon silhouette in dark-grey bricks, a starry backdrop of black plates + white round-stud stars, the quiet-frontier-night stage.

CANYON AMBUSH — a narrow stacked-plate canyon pass of deep-orange and dark-tan layered walls, a trail of tan plates threading the gap, a rockfall-build of grey round bricks overhead, a hidden-ledge build on each canyon rim, the trap-set tension stage.

RAILROAD CONSTRUCTION — a half-laid Technic-rail grade of tan and dark-grey plates stretching to a vanishing point, a supply-flatcar with tie-pile builds, a water-tower crane-build, tool-crate stacks, a temporary-camp of tent builds beside the grade, the iron-road-progress stage.

ASSAY OFFICE — a brick assay-office facade with a front-counter of tan plates, a set of printed-tile scale builds, ore-sample crates, a locked iron-door build, gold-ingot stack builds behind the counter, the frontier-valuation tension stage.

LIVERY STABLE — a wide brick livery-stable with a tall hay-loft above, stall dividers of dark-brown plates, hay-bale builds of yellow 2x4 bricks, a water-bucket on a Technic-rod hook, a saddle-rack build by the wide door, the working-stable stage.

TRADING POST — a brick trading-post with a porch of dark-tan plates, rocking-chair builds, goods-crate stacks, pelt-rack builds of tan brackets, a freight-wagon at the hitching-rail, a hand-painted tile shop-sign above the door, the frontier-commerce stage.

BOOM-TOWN STREET — a rapidly-built brick boom-town block of mismatched clapboard-tile facades, a brick land-office, a brick assay-storefront, a muddy tan-plate central street, a crowded hitching-rail lined with horse-builds, the gold-rush-frenzy energy stage.

SHERIFF OFFICE — a brick sheriff-office with iron-bar jail-cell builds along one wall, a wanted-poster printed-tile wall, a weapon-rack of brown bar-pieces, a roll-top desk build, a deputy-badge printed tile on the counter, the law-and-order tension stage.

CATTLE DRIVE — an open tan-plate prairie of flat 8x8 plates, a loose herd of brown bull-builds, flank-rider horse-builds on each side, a chuck-wagon build at the rear with a cooking-pot on a Technic-rod crane, the long-trail-labor stage.

MESA LOOKOUT — a tall stacked-plate mesa of orange and tan layers with a flat summit-plate, a signal-fire pit of trans-orange bricks, a spyglass-build on a Technic-rod tripod, a lone horse-build tethered to a post, the high-watch tension stage.

MINE-HEADFRAME RIDGE — a tall brick mine-headframe + ore-bin builds perched on a stacked-plate ridge, switchback ore-cart tracks descending in dark-grey rails, a boom-town of small brick buildings visible on the flat below, the industrial-frontier scale stage.

BOOM-TOWN BANK OPENING — a newly-built brick bank with a grand pillar-facade of white 1x4 bricks, a vault-door build in polished dark-grey plates, a queue-rope of chain-links, money-bag builds stacked inside, a gold-lettered tile sign above, the commerce-and-ambition stage.

RAILROAD BRIDGE STANDOFF — a Technic-rail trestle bridge of dark-grey lattice-plate builds spanning a trans-blue gorge, a halted locomotive on the span, a barrier of stacked-plate boulders across the track, the high-bridge confrontation stage.

PROSPECTOR CAMP RIVER BEND — a trans-blue plate river bend with a gold-pan build on a gravel-bar of tan jumper-plates, a canvas-tent build, a sluice-box channel of angled tiles, a mule-pack build, supply-crate stacks, the solitary-labor frontier stage.

FRONTIER TELEGRAPH OFFICE — a brick telegraph-office with a Technic-rod wire strung between tall pole-builds down the main-street, a message-ticker build on the counter, a printed-tile dispatch board, a brick waiting-bench outside, the communication-age-arrives tension stage.

OUTLAW HIDEOUT CANYON CAVE — a stacked-plate canyon wall with a wide cave-mouth of dark-grey arch bricks, a hidden camp of bedroll builds + crate-stacks inside, a lookout-ledge build above the entrance, stolen-strongbox builds stacked in the shadows, the fugitive-den stage.
